label: preliminary automated evaluation, not human-validated ground truth

judge.nli_aggregation: supported only when a passage entails and no passage contradicts; disagreement is uncertain

nli.role: pragmatic NLI substitute, not AGREE TRUE-NLI

metrics.ucr_undefined_when: answer has no confidently classified factual claim
metrics.conservative_ucr: uncertain factual claims counted as unsupported
metrics.coverage_evidence_conditional: facts supported by the evidence actually shown to that condition
metrics.coverage_common_reference: one fact list per question from all nonempty label=2 evidence
metrics.coverage_undefined_when: the chosen fact list is empty

ucr_counting.supported: excluded from the numerator, included in the denominator
ucr_counting.unsupported: included in the numerator and the denominator
ucr_counting.contradicted: subtype of unsupported: included in the numerator and the denominator, also counted separately
ucr_counting.uncertain: excluded from primary UCR; included as unsupported in ucr_conservative
ucr_counting.evaluation_error: excluded from primary UCR and from ucr_conservative
